name: Wide Playmakers 4-3-3

slots.why: Sweeper Keeper (Defend) gives the back line an extra short passing option and can deal with balls beyond the defence without requiring an aggressive sweeper role.
Support full-back is essential for width because the wide creator ahead of him moves inside; stamina, work rate and crossing matter more here than in a conventional 4-3-3.
Ball-Playing Defender (Defend) starts possession cleanly and can find midfield before the opposition closes the creative players.
Central Defender (Defend) supplies the simpler defensive partner. Cover remains an alternative when pace and anticipation justify it.

Wing-Back (Support) provides the width and pressing behind the attacking advanced playmaker, while the left full-back and fixed DM protect the structure. Full-Back (Support) is a safer fallback that trades away width and pressure on this flank. Stamina, work rate and crossing matter for both roles.
Defensive Midfielder (Defend) is the fixed anchor. With both wide creators drifting inside and the BBM moving, this role must hold rather than chase possession.
Box-to-Box Midfielder (Support) supplies the running and defensive work the two creators do not, while also arriving beyond them when space opens.
Central Midfielder (Support) is the reliable connector who keeps possession moving between the defensive unit, full-backs and two creators.
Trequartista (Attack) starts wide then roams into pockets to create. He is deliberately protected from defensive work, so his technical and creative quality must justify that freedom.

Advanced Playmaker (Attack) moves inside from the right half-space to create and combine, giving a second creative source without duplicating the Trequartista exactly. His attacking duty preserves penetration alongside the pressing forward, with the right wing-back supplying width outside him.
Pressing Forward (Attack) supplies vertical running and leads the press, compensating for the limited defensive contribution of the two wide creators.

description: A possession-oriented 4-3-3 with two different creators starting wide and moving inside, a left full-back and supporting right wing-back supplying width, and a true holding midfielder protecting the structure behind them.
whyGood: The Trequartista and wide Advanced Playmaker receive from unusual starting positions and can combine between the lines, while the wide defenders stretch the pitch and the BBM/PF provide the running. A fixed DM prevents all of that movement from leaving the centre-backs exposed.
whyThisShape: Both nominal wide attackers want to move inside, so the wide defenders become essential width providers. A supporting wing-back on the right supplies enough width for the AP on Attack without losing his penetration; the supporting full-back on the left and fixed DM retain defensive security. Keeping a full-back on the right is a safer fallback, but trades away width and pressing. Shorter passing, Play Out Of Defence and Work Ball Into Box create the controlled possession those creators need; Higher Tempo stops the circulation becoming static once an opening appears. The Trequartista is granted freedom while the AP offers a more structured second creator. Behind them, the BBM supplies running, the CM connects play and DM(D) holds. Counter-Press tries to win losses back around the creators, but Hold Shape after clean regains keeps the tactic centred on controlled creation rather than bypassing its strongest players.
whenToUse: When your best attacking players are creators rather than conventional touchline wingers and your left full-back and right wing-back have enough engine to supply width for them.
whenNotToUse: When the full-backs lack stamina or crossing, the holding midfielder cannot defend space reliably, or the opposition can press the first build-up line so effectively that the two creators rarely receive facing goal.

instructionRationale.Fairly Wide: Creates room for the wide defenders to stretch the pitch while the two nominal wide attackers move inside; a supporting right wing-back supplies the extra width when the advanced playmaker attacks inside.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Connects the build-up players to the two creators through repeatable short combinations.
instructionRationale.Play Out Of Defence: Uses the Sweeper Keeper, BPD, DM and supporting midfielders to establish controlled possession.
instructionRationale.Higher Tempo: Moves the ball quickly once the creators have pulled the defensive shape out of position.
instructionRationale.Work Ball Into Box: Lets the Trequartista and Advanced Playmaker create the final action rather than settling for low-quality shots.
instructionRationale.Be More Expressive: Gives the two specialist creators freedom to exploit the spaces they find.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Uses the PF, BBM and nearby midfielders to contest losses before the wide creators have to recover fully; the supporting right wing-back adds pressure on that flank.
instructionRationale.Hold Shape: Keeps clean regains connected to the creative structure instead of immediately launching low-percentage counters.
instructionRationale.Higher Line of Engagement: Keeps the team close enough to its creators to sustain possession and counter-pressure.
instructionRationale.More Urgent Pressing: Closes the ball down quickly near the creators, so the counter-press can win possession back high rather than letting the opposition settle.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: Avoids adding high-line recovery demands to a shape already committing both full-backs to provide width.

keyRequirements: Two genuinely high-level creators suited to receiving from wide starting positions and operating between the lines
A left full-back and supporting right wing-back with the stamina, work rate and crossing to provide nearly all of the natural width
A disciplined holding midfielder who protects the centre-backs rather than chasing the ball
A high-engine Box-to-Box midfielder and reliable supporting midfielder to carry the defensive and connective workload
A Pressing Forward with the work rate and movement to stretch the defence and lead pressure
Enough passing quality in the first build-up line to get the ball to the creators consistently
